facts.fact: The US Country Commercial Guide says the government inaugurated a national data centre in Nouakchott in May 2025, EIB-backed; the document does not say it rents to outside customers.
The US Country Commercial Guide states the Nouakchott national data centre inaugurated in May 2025 is Tier III (stated by the guide, no certifier named).
